verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk and centred. It leaves wide dead gutters on the left and right, the headline and CTA are small for the canvas, and the legal block is tiny, though the reading order and grouping stay intact. B fills the width better with a bold headline and a large suitcase. But it moves the CTA to the top right beside the logo, so the action comes before the headline and the reading order breaks. Its legal text is shrunk to an illegible size and jammed under the subhead, and the suitcase crowds the right edge.
